record.paper_title: Open Problems on Ultrafilters and Some Connections to the Continuum
record.original_question: Let λ be an infinite cardinal, let I be a set with |I| = λ, and let D be a regular ultrafilter on I. For the ultrapower (ω,<)^I/D of the usual linear order on the natural numbers, define C(D) to be the set of pairs (κ1,κ2) such that κ1 and κ2 are infinite regular cardinals, κ1 + κ2 ≤ |I|, and (ω,<)^I/D has a (κ1,κ2)-cut: a strictly increasing sequence of cofinality κ1 and a strictly decreasing sequence of cofinality κ2 with all left-side elements below all right-side elements and with no element of the ultrapower lying strictly between the two sequences. Which sets can occur as C(D) for regular ultrafilters D?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\lambda$ be an infinite cardinal and let $I$ be a set with $|I|=\lambda$. An ultrafilter $D$ on $I$ is called regular if there exists a family $\{X_i : i\in I\}\subseteq D$ such that every $i_0\in I$ belongs to only finitely many of the $X_i$. Form the ultrapower $(\omega,<)^I/D$ of the standard linear order on the natural numbers.

For infinite regular cardinals $\kappa_1,\kappa_2$ with $\kappa_1+\kappa_2\le |I|$, say that $(\omega,<)^I/D$ has a $(\kappa_1,\kappa_2)$-cut if there exist sequences $\langle a_\alpha : \alpha<\kappa_1\rangle$ and $\langle b_\beta : \beta<\kappa_2\rangle$ in the ultrapower such that:
- $\alpha<\alpha'<\kappa_1 \Rightarrow a_\alpha < a_{\alpha'}$ in $(\omega,<)^I/D$,
- $\beta<\beta'<\kappa_2 \Rightarrow b_\beta > b_{\beta'}$ in $(\omega,<)^I/D$,
- $a_\alpha < b_\beta$ for all $\alpha<\kappa_1$, $\beta<\kappa_2$,
- there is no element $c$ of $(\omega,<)^I/D$ with $a_\alpha<c<b_\beta$ for all $\alpha<\kappa_1$, $\beta<\kappa_2$.

Define the cut spectrum
$$C(D)=\{(\kappa_1,\kappa_2): \kappa_1,\kappa_2 \text{ infinite regular cardinals with } \kappa_1+\kappa_2\le|I|, \text{ and } (\omega,<)^I/D \text{ has a }(\kappa_1,\kappa_2)\text{-cut}\}.$$

Determine, as $\lambda$ varies over infinite cardinals and $D$ varies over regular ultrafilters on sets of size $\lambda$, exactly which subsets of $\{(\kappa_1,\kappa_2):\kappa_1,\kappa_2\text{ infinite regular},\ \kappa_1+\kappa_2\le\lambda\}$ arise as $C(D)$.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem of fully characterizing the possible cut spectra $C(D)$ of regular ultrafilters is a longstanding open question studied extensively by Malliaris and Shelah. Major partial results are known: regular ultrafilters cannot omit $(\kappa,\kappa)$-cuts under suitable treetops hypotheses, and the celebrated $p=t$ theorem of Malliaris–Shelah arose from related symmetric-cut analysis. However, the full classification of which sets can occur as $C(D)$ remains open, with the question continuing to drive current work on ultrafilter construction and Keisler's order.

status_evidence.title: Cofinality spectrum theorems in model theory, set theory and general topology
status_evidence.snippet: If D is a regular ultrafilter on λ with λ⁺-treetops and κ<λ⁺ is regular, then C(D) has no (κ,κ)-cuts.
status_evidence.claim: Partial results restrict which pairs can lie in C(D), but the full characterization is not given.

status_evidence.title: On ultrafilter construction (2025)
status_evidence.snippet: Construction of regular ultrafilters is one thread in a broader classification program.
status_evidence.claim: Construction problems for regular ultrafilters and their spectra remain an active research direction.
